scope.miniquest_scope_note: Barbarian Training is partial Firemaking/pyre dialogue, not full completion; Skippy is required for the Mogre bone.
scope.excluded: Chapter 3.7, shared components, old audits, macro routing, checkbox IDs and mandatory/optional flags.

methodology.required_item_check: Current pinned Quest Helper getItemRequirements, definitions, quantities, conditional routing and quest-local supplier steps inspected for every primary quest/miniquest in scope. Not a keyword/contradiction-only pass.
methodology.route_check: All 65 RouteSteps scanned, including grouped cleanup and Quest Cape journal rows. Nonquest skill rows are documented separately.
methodology.macro_comparison: Compared current BRUH source before the shared executor outage; source coordinates below are zero-based chapter/section/step indices, not public step numbers.
methodology.actual_bank: No account bank export was available. Supplies are conditional recovery actions based on actual remaining stock; RNG yields and fixed inventory budgets are never presented as guaranteed completion.
methodology.presentation: Compact visible preflight plus closed-by-default ExpandableNote labelled Quest preparation; no new checkboxes or IDs.
methodology.source_freshness: QH and BRUH commits are pinned. Canonical OSRS Wiki/Jagex references were used where accessible. Direct Wiki reads were robots-blocked and many search snippets were cached over a year ago; those alone were not treated as fresh verification of changed mechanics. Unresolved supplier/mechanic questions are recorded below; no Fandom or third-party Wiki mirrors are used as cited authority.

quest_helper.extra_reference: TearsOfGuthix.java was read for sapphire-lantern recovery; HopespearsWill.java was read to confirm that the separately mentioned optional miniquest adds no mandatory Chapter 3 consumer.

statuses.fixed: Missing requirement, source, form, quantity, reserve or recovery was added/corrected.
statuses.covered: Existing route already supplies the input or step; verified at its actual consumer.
statuses.quest-local: Quest itself supplies the relevant tools/materials; guide identifies local pickup and avoids unnecessary outside manufacture.
statuses.unverified: Source or mechanic remains uncertain; not represented as a verified mandatory dependency.

cross_chapter_handoffs.required: Root supplies full repeatable Prayer/ordinary restore/energy/antipoison recipes and ingredient/shop recovery. Links appear at later combat consumers and Skippy.
